brief:
Gaza's football academies face existential strain as ongoing conflict destroys facilities and creates severe shortages, the Palestine News Network reported. Once central to developing youth talent across the territory, the academies now struggle to operate amid widespread destruction. Despite the obstacles, they continue functioning as one of few outlets for children traumatized by years of conflict.

The academies provide more than athletic training in a context where recreational opportunities have contracted sharply. Coaches and administrators work to sustain programs that offer psychological relief and normalcy to young players navigating displacement and loss.

title: War threatens Gaza's football academies and young players' futures
